sourceTitle: Ahpra / Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia -- internationally qualified nurses and midwives; Anmac skilled migration skills assessments
effectiveDateNote: The document states no effective date for any of these fees.

fees.quote: Full skills assessment Apply for this assessment if you are registered as a nurse or midwife in an approved overseas country and meet the eligibility requirements below. ● Fee: $595 AUD ● Time to apply: 25 minutes (average, not including document preparation) ● Current wait time for assessment to start: 6–8 weeks
fees.appliesTo: Apply for this assessment if you are registered as a nurse or midwife in an approved overseas country and meet the eligibility requirements below.

nursing.quote: For nursing applicants To qualify for a Full skills assessment, you must: ● hold a relevant nursing qualification ● be current or previously registered as a nurse in one of the following countries: ● Canada ● Hong Kong ● Ireland ● Singapore ● Spain ● United Kingdom ● United States. If your qualification is not a Bachelor of Nursing from Canada, Hong Kong, Ireland, the United Kingdom or the United States, you must also: ● have completed a qualification that led to general nursing registration after 1 January 2017 ● have successfully completed a regulatory examination process in one of the countries listed above (where applicable) ● have completed at least 1,800 hours of paid registered nurse work experience since 1 January 2017 in that same country.
nursing.additionalIfNotBachelorOfNursingFrom: Canada, Hong Kong, Ireland, the United Kingdom or the United States
additionalRequirements: have completed a qualification that led to general nursing registration after 1 January 2017
have successfully completed a regulatory examination process in one of the countries listed above (where applicable)

midwifery.quote: For midwifery applicants To qualify for a Full skills assessment, you must: ● hold a minimum Bachelor of Midwifery qualification from Ireland, the United Kingdom or the United States ● be registered as a midwife in the same country as your qualification.
requirements: hold a minimum Bachelor of Midwifery qualification from Ireland, the United Kingdom or the United States
be registered as a midwife in the same country as your qualification

laterAustralianOrNzRegistration.quote: If you apply for a Full skills assessment and later become registered in Australia or New Zealand, the Full skills assessment process and fees will still apply.

waitTimeToStart.note: Wait time for the assessment to START, as stated; the document gives no time to complete the assessment.

fees.quote: This assessment is for the following occupations only: ● Nursing Support Worker (ANZSCO 423312) ● Personal Care Assistant (ANZSCO 423313) Fee: $545 AUD Time to apply: 25 minutes (average, not including document preparation) Current wait time for assessment to start: 6–8 weeks
fees.appliesTo: This assessment is for the following occupations only:

eligibility.quote: To qualify for a Direct care skills assessment, you must meet all requirements of at least one of the following pathways: Qualification pathway You must hold a minimum Certificate III qualification in a relevant field (including nursing-related study or personal or aged care) that: ● was at least 6 months in duration ● was completed face-to-face ● included at least 120 hours of practical experience. Work experience pathway You must have at least 12 months of full-time paid work experience that: ● was completed within the last 5 years ● was in a relevant area, including nursing, direct care or aged care.

relevantDefinition.quote: ‘Relevant’ means a course or work where direct care roles and responsibilities are the focus. This does not include midwifery, disability or child care.

waitTimeToStart.note: Wait time for the assessment to START, as stated; the document gives no time to complete the assessment.

fees.quote: Modified skills assessment Apply for this assessment if you are currently registered as a nurse or midwife in Australia or New Zealand. ● Fee: $395 AUD ● Time to apply: 20 minutes (average, not including document preparation) ● Current wait time for assessment to start: 6–8 weeks
fees.appliesTo: Apply for this assessment if you are currently registered as a nurse or midwife in Australia or New Zealand.

eligibility.quote: To qualify for a Modified skills assessment, you need current registration from one of the following: ● Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA/Ahpra) ● Nursing Council of New Zealand (NCNZ) ● Midwifery Council of New Zealand (MCNZ).
currentRegistrationWith: Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA/Ahpra)

generalCodesWithoutWorkExperience.quote: If you do not have work experience, choose one of these general codes that apply to you: ● 254499 Registered Nurse (Not Elsewhere Classified) ● 254111 Midwife ● 411411 Enrolled Nurse.
